decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a complex transition ~410–450 with cross-axis asymmetry and possible partial return in U, and (2) a prolonged monotonic shift from ~680 to 729 with divergent behavior in U at ~710. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth motion without ambiguous superposed changes.

regions.observation: N-component shows a multi-sample downward shift around index 420–430, followed by a slower decline; E and U show correlated gradual descent starting ~410, with possible opposing return in U near 440–450 not clearly mirrored in N/E.

From ~680 onward, all three components exhibit a sustained, near-linear trend: N drops sharply then stabilizes, E declines steadily, U rises gradually—suggesting a platform-like offset or slow slip; abrupt multi-sample drop in U at ~710 lacks clear counterpart in N/E, warranting closer inspection of boundaries.
